requirements.quote: Envelope <=140 W x 100 H x 55 D mm including clip/fixed protrusions; exclude removable plugs/cables. Mass <=0.75 kg.
requirements.text: Device dimensions and mass must meet specified limits.

requirements.quote: Fanless metal case; tool-free 35 mm rail mount to EN 60715; IP30 minimum. Bond protective earth where safety design requires.
requirements.text: Device must have a fanless metal case, tool-free rail mount, and meet IP30.

requirements.quote: Operate -20 to +60 C without throttling; store -40 to +85 C. Humidity: 5-95% RH, non-condensing. Altitude <=2,000 m.
requirements.text: Device must operate and store within specified temperature, humidity, and altitude ranges.

requirements.quote: Maintain component junction temperatures at least 10 C below rated maxima at +60 C ambient. Installation clearances shall not exceed 50 mm above/below and 20 mm at each side.
requirements.text: Component temperatures must stay below limits, and installation clearances must be adhered to.

requirements.quote: Vibration: 10-150 Hz, 1 g peak, 10 sweeps/axis, three axes. Shock: 15 g, 11 ms half-sine, three shocks in each of six directions, mounted on specified DIN rail.
requirements.text: Device must withstand specified vibration and shock conditions.

requirements.quote: Durable unit label with model, revision, serial, input rating, country of origin and approved compliance marks. Terminal legend shall remain readable after 50 IPA wipe cycles.
requirements.text: Device label must be durable and readable after solvent exposure.

requirements.quote: Specify materials, finish, torque and tolerances. Keep ports and release controls accessible beside adjacent equipment; define cable clearance and prevent power/bus connector reversal.
requirements.text: Materials, finish, and tolerances must be specified; ports must be accessible and prevent connector reversal.

requirements.quote: Cover imagery and connector locations are illustrative; dimensions and ME-01 to ME-06 govern. Obtain layout approval at G0 before tooling commitment.
requirements.text: Layout approval must be obtained before tooling commitment.
